title: Cartwise Shopper Batches Mileage Disputes and the Shopper's Mileage-Claim Filing Tool
content:
A shopper who holds that the miles she drove on a completed batch of Cartwise Shopper Batches ran well beyond the estimated route files a mileage dispute on that batch herself, and the amount she claims on it is the mileage claim; a batch whose pay has since been finalized still counts as completed here.

## When the mileage claim is settled

The mileage claim is not fixed until the batch's earnings entries carry a reversal on the verified not-delivered ground for the orders that wrong-address violations recorded against the batch show as not delivered.

Read the other way: while wrong-address violations are recorded against the batch and its earnings entries carry no reversal on the verified not-delivered ground for those orders, the mileage claim is not yet fixed.

## Who files the dispute

The mileage dispute is the shopper's own filing on her own completed batch, finalized or not, carrying the mileage claim as the amount claimed.

## Situation of use and capability of `submit_mileage_claim_29030431`

`submit_mileage_claim_29030431` lets the shopper file a mileage dispute on one of her own completed shopper batches, saying the miles she drove ran beyond what her mileage pay covers. One call files a single pay dispute with the reason mileage underpaid on the named batch, carrying the amount the shopper claims, stamped with the current time and standing as submitted; the shopper sees the new dispute and its reference number among her pay disputes at once.

## How it is invoked

It is the shopper's own tool: the agent unlocks `submit_mileage_claim_29030431` and hands it over, and the customer themselves — here the shopper — runs it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `batch_id` | The batch number of the shopper's own batch the mileage dispute is filed on, as read out to the shopper from the batch lookup | Id |
| `claimed_amount_usd` | The amount the shopper claims is owed for mileage, in USD | A positive number with 2 decimal places; stored rounded to 2 decimal places |

The reason is not a parameter: every dispute this tool files carries the reason mileage underpaid.

## Return

A text receipt of a dictionary carrying `batch_pay_dispute_id` (the reference number of the new dispute), `batch_id`, `dispute_reason` (always `mileage_underpaid`), `claimed_amount_usd` (USD, 2 decimal places), `dispute_status` (always submitted) and `created_at` (the submission time, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS). Receiving the `batch_pay_dispute_id` means the mileage dispute is filed.
